attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is the teacher of the two Komel ascetics saint.gr keeps on 16 Μαΐου, «Όσιοι Κασσιανός και Λαυρέντιος», whose pages another reader read on that day and who have no folders yet; he is not the corpus's `arsenius-of-komel`, a different man of the same forest, and not `cornelius-the-centurion`. The page calls him ιερομόναχος of his own monastery, appointed by Metropolitan Simon, and gives no hymn.
